positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Contract web developer working onsite at large electrical utility.  Our small team develops and maintains their outage tracking & management system.  Used by 900 people, 24/7.
- Design, develop & update all aspects of the system
- Meet with customers and partners to clarify and prioritize stories
- 24/7 support on a rotating basis (3 people on call at all times)

Agile, Ruby on Rails, Apache, MySQL, SQL Server, TDD, Minitest, Cucumber, Pair Programming, ActiveRecord, HTML/CSS, REST, JSON, XML, Continuous Integration, SVN, Splunk.

positions.title: Software Designer
positions.description:
Web developer for HP's Instant Ink Subscription Service - instantink.hpconnected.com
- Developed & updated front end components.
- Developed & updated components which trigger ink shipments and send event data to HP's business intelligence systems.

Agile, Ruby on Rails, TDD, RSpec, Pair Programming, ActiveRecord, Jasmine, Javascript, HTML/CSS, Continuous Integration, Git, Pivotal Tracker, PHP

positions.title: Software Designer
positions.description:
Created targeting engine for coupon recommendation and printing service - savings.hpconnected.com
•	Use customer preferences, demographics, coupon usage, and behavioral attributes to display coupons in most relevant order.
•	Created sophisticated tool for optimizing targeting engine parameters using data from real customer coupon selections.
•	Savings Center has been in use since March 2012.
•	Agile, Java, Perl

positions.title: Technical Marketing Engineer - Software
positions.description:
•	Handled complex customer escalations for HP’s Edgeline multi-function printers, with an emphasis on integration into the customer’s environment (network, SMTP, LDAP, etc.); digital sending features; print drivers, security features, and the embedded web server.  This involved complex troubleshooting and coordination of resources throughout HP to resolve customer issues.
•	Incorporated lessons learned from customer escalations and the field into new product designs and test plans.
•	Trained field service personnel on new products prior to release.
•	Managed the delivery of firmware releases to the field personnel and customers.

positions.title: Contract Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Overhauled freight message processing applications to link shipping client applications to backend systems and databases.  C++, Oracle embedded SQL, XML, SOAP, Solaris/Unix, message parsing.
•	Researched and resolved customer Java client access problems.  Java security, digital certificates, SOAP.
•	Overhauled ASP.NET pages to conform to new web application design.  ASP.NET, HTML, JavaScript, C#, XML.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
2003 – 2005 Software Designer, Enterprise Solutions
•	Prototyped document capture, process and route solutions for multi-function printers, digital copiers, and digital senders.  Gathered customer requirements and developed detailed use cases for enabling semi-automated capture, processing and routing of paper forms and documents, including capture of document meta-data both at the device front panel and automatically using OCR.  C++, Visual Basic, VS.NET installer.
•	Created and qualified HP-branded version of 3rd party document capture, process and route tool, and brought it to market.  HP Autostore, FileNet, SharePoint Server.
•	Partner-facing engineer for new Digital-Send Enablers SDK.  Helped external partners use the SDK prior to release, and worked with the development team to incorporate features to meet partner needs.  Java, HP Chai JVM.
2000 – 2003 Software Engineer, Mobile Printing Lab
•	Developed printing component plug-in for Visual Studio .NET to enable developers to drag-and-drop printing into their PocketPC applications.  C#, C++, VS.NET, PocketPC.
•	Customer-facing engineer for mobile printing lab.  Developed demonstrations and made presentations to management and to customers at trade shows.  Gathered requirements from customers and worked with the development team to modify our solutions to meet customer needs.  Developed a beverage truck printing demonstration for PocketPC that was shown at CeBIT 2003.  C++, C#, Java, JNI, .NET, PocketPC, 802.11b, Bluetooth.
•	Developed an enterprise Java service and infrastructure to enable remote rendering and printing of documents from mobile devices such as the RIM Blackberry.  Java, C++, JNI, XML, SOAP.

positions.title: Internet Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Created and enhanced features for HP’s photo sharing website hpphoto.com.  Features included album viewing, photo printing, greeting cards, postcards.  Created and managed website metrics and metrics gathering tools for all servers.  ASP, VBScript, JavaScript, XML, HTML, Perl, IIS, SQL Server.  
•	System operations engineer for an internal internet startup to provide web-based consumer expressions applications such as printable greeting cards – printableexpressions.com.  Developed metrics strategy, created and purchased tools to gather and analyze website metrics, sourced and managed web hosting services.  Website traffic was several hundred thousand visitors per month.  Perl, CGI, HTML, JavaScript, Apache, IIS, Oracle.

positions.title: Software Design Engineer
positions.description: •	Enhanced Win32 drivers for HP’s inkjet printers.  C++, GDI+, Visual Studio.

positions.title: Manufacturing Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
Computer Integrated Manufacturing
•	As part of a Knowledge System design team, led the development and integration of web-based software tools to facilitate the capture and sharing of knowledge for a printer manufacturing organization. C++, Perl, CGI, HTML, Informix, socio-technical systems design, knowledge system design.
•	Expanded HP’s inkjet printer production capacity 100-fold in 3 years.
•	Worked closely with industrial and manufacturing engineers on a wide variety of projects:
•	Board ID – Developed a system of barcode label applicators, barcode scanners, software, databases, interfaces to assembly robots, and display tools for monitoring and controlling the flow of printed circuit assemblies (PCAs) through our PCA factory.  This enabled each PCA to be identified and tracked at each work station, triggering the correct ‘recipe’ of parts to be placed on the PCA.  C, C++, database design (Informix), HP-UX.
•	Information Infrastructure – Led a team through a visioning process, then designed and built an ‘information infrastructure’ for data and knowledge gathering, sharing and display in our PCA factory.  C++, Perl, Tcl/Tk, CGI, HTML, JavaScript, Informix.
•	Cool Tool – Used PCA data from Board ID to create and display an interactive 3-D visualization of PCAs through the factory in space and time.  In 2005 I was granted a patent (#6882977) that uses this same concept for tracking customer activity and value. Perl, C++, Informix, Interactive 3-D Viewer.
•	Industrial Modeling – Developed tools to gather, process, and display very large amounts of factory data which was used by industrial engineers to build and validate models for new factory configurations and expansions.  Perl, C++, Informix.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Command, Control, Communications, and Intelligence (C3I) Systems

Developed large C3I systems, from requirements analysis through design, development, testing and documentation, using OOD and Ada.

volunteerExperiences.description:
Serve on the board of directors for the Columbia Gorge Refuge Stewards, which is the friends group for the three USFWS refuges in the western Columbia River Gorge: Steigerwald Lake, Franz Lake, and Pierce National Wildlife Refuges.  Together these refuges provide 1,968 acres of protected habitat for wildlife.  

The Stewards' mission is to preserve and enhance the native species of Steigerwald Lake, Franz Lake and Pierce National Wildlife Refuges through public education, advocacy and habitat restoration.

We do this by:
- Recruiting, training & leading volunteers in support of the Refuges through habitat restoration, citizen science, environmental education and other efforts.
- Making the public more aware of the Refuges through personal contacts, presentations, the media, community events, and the Internet.
- Serving as advocates for the Refuges.
- Introducing young people to the habitats and inhabitants of the Refuges.

Please visit us at refugestewards.org and facebook.com/refugestewards

volunteerExperiences.role: Volunteer crew leader, habitat restoration, GIS data/mapping, tour leader, many other roles
volunteerExperiences.description:
Frequent volunteer including:
- Habitat restoration (e.g. planting native plants, remove unused fencing, remove invasive plants)
- Biological data gathering (bat surveys, invasive plant surveys with GPS, trail camera surveys, train/wildlife collision surveys)
- GIS/mapping (e.g. calculate acreages, create data maps)
- Lead volunteer groups doing habitat restoration
- Lead public wildlife watching hikes at night (to see and hear bats, owls, etc.)
- Help the refuge manager with technical requests

volunteerExperience.description:
Serve on the board of directors for the Columbia Gorge Refuge Stewards, which is the friends group for the three USFWS refuges in the western Columbia River Gorge: Steigerwald Lake, Franz Lake, and Pierce National Wildlife Refuges.  Together these refuges provide 1,968 acres of protected habitat for wildlife.  

The Stewards' mission is to preserve and enhance the native species of Steigerwald Lake, Franz Lake and Pierce National Wildlife Refuges through public education, advocacy and habitat restoration.

We do this by:
- Recruiting, training & leading volunteers in support of the Refuges through habitat restoration, citizen science, environmental education and other efforts.
- Making the public more aware of the Refuges through personal contacts, presentations, the media, community events, and the Internet.
- Serving as advocates for the Refuges.
- Introducing young people to the habitats and inhabitants of the Refuges.

Please visit us at refugestewards.org and facebook.com/refugestewards

- Help the refuge manager with technical requests
